1.text: Balāmu abonye yuko Uwiteka akunda guha Abisirayeli umugisha, ntiyagenda nka mbere gushaka indagu, ahubwo yerekeza amaso ye mu butayu.

2.text: Balāmu arambura amaso, abona Abisirayeli baganditse nk'uko imiryango yabo iri. Umwuka w'Imana amuzaho,

3.text: aca umugani uhanura ati“Balāmu mwene Bewori aravuga,Umuntu wari uhumirije amaso aravuga.

4.text: Haravuga uwumva amagambo y'Imana,Uwerekwa Ishoborabyose,Uwikubita hasi akagira amaso areba.

5.text: Ati ‘Erega amahema yawe ni meza,Wa bwoko bwa Yakobo we.Ubuturo bwawe ni bwiza,Wa bwoko bwa Isirayeli we.

6.text: Burambuye nk'ibikombe,Nk'imirima y'uburabyo yegereye uruzi,Nk'imisāga Uwiteka yateye,Nk'imyerezi imeze iruhande rw'amazi.

7.text: Amazi azatemba avuye mu ndobo z'ubwo bwoko,Urubyaro rwabwo ruzaba aho amazi menshi ari.Umwami wabwo azasumba Agagi,Ubwami bwabwo buzashyirwa hejuru.’

8.text: Imana yabukuye muri Egiputa ni yo ibujyana,Ifite amaboko nk'ay'imbogo,Buzarya amahanga abubereye ababisha,Buzamenagura amagufwa yabo,Buzabahinguranisha imyambi yabwo.

9.text: Bwarabunze buryama nk'intare y'ingabo,Nk'intare y'ingore, bwavumburwa na nde?Uzakwifuriza umugisha wese awuhabwe,Uzakuvuma wese avumwe.”

10.text: Balāmu yikongereza uburakari bwa Balaki, Balaki akubita mu mashyi abwira Balāmu ati “Nagutumiriye kuvuma ababisha banjye, none ubahesheje umugisha musa aka gatatu!

11.text: Nuko none mpungira iwawe. Nashakaga kugushyira hejuru nkaguha icyubahiro cyinshi, none Uwiteka yakubujije icyubahiro.”

12.text: Balāmu asubiza Balaki ati “Sinabwiye n'intumwa zawe wantumyeho nti

13.text: ‘Naho Balaki yampa ifeza n'izahabu byuzuye inzu ye, sinabasha gukora ibitandukana n'itegeko ry'Uwiteka, gukora icyiza cyangwa ikibi nihangiye, icyo Uwiteka azajya ambwira ni cyo nzajya mvuga?’

14.text: None ngiye mu bwoko bwanjye. Reka ngusobanurire ibyo buriya bwoko buzagirira ubwawe mu bihe bizaza.”

15.text: Aca umugani uhanura ati“Balāmu mwene Bewori aravuga,Umuntu wari uhumirije amaso aravuga.

16.text: Haravuga uwumva amagambo y'Imana,Akamenya ubwenge bw'Isumbabyose,Uwerekwa Ishoborabyose,Uwikubita hasi akagira amaso areba.

17.text: Ati ‘Ndamureba ariko si ubu,Ndamwitegereza ariko ntandi bugufi.Inyenyeri izakomoka mu bwoko bwa Yakobo,Inkoni y'ubwami izabonekaIturutse mu bwoko bwa Isirayeli,Izagiriza inkiko z'i Mowabu,Izatsinda hasi Abasheti bose.

18.text: Edomu hazahindūrwa,Seyiri na ho hazahindūrwa,Abaho bari ababisha b'Abisirayeli,Ubwoko bwa Isirayeli buzakora iby'ubutwari.

19.text: Ubwoko bwa Yakobo buzakomokwaho n'utwara ibihugu,Azarimbura abacitse ku icumu bo mu midugudu.’ ”

20.text: Yitegera Abamaleki aca umugani uhanura ati“Abamaleki bari aba mbere baruta ayandi mahanga,Ariko ibya nyuma byabo bizaba kurimbuka.”

21.text: Yitegera Abakeni aca umugani uhanura ati“Ubuturo bwawe bukomeye ubutavaho,Icyari cyawe kiri ku gitare,

22.text: Ariko Abakeni bazanyagwa.Bizaba ryari?Bizaba ubwo Abashuri bazakujyana uri imbohe.”

23.text: Arongera aca umugani uhanura ati“Ayii we! Ni nde uzabasha kubaho,Ubwo Imana izakora ibyo?

24.text: Ariko inkuge zizaturuka ku nkombe y'i Kitimu,Zibabaze Abashuri, zibabaze n'Abeberi,Maze na bo bazarimbuka.”

25.text: Balāmu arahaguruka, aragenda ngo asubire iwe. Balaki na we asubira iwe.
